categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No 83 of Block 07) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner information, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses exclusively on land registration matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category.
